title: Bellman-Certified Rounding for Sparse Policy Deployment in MDPs
abstract: arXiv:2610.00325v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous policy optimization may spread an update across many states, even when deployment permits only a few complete state-level changes. We study how much discounted return can be retained when continuous row mixtures are rounded to sparse binary policies in finite MDPs. Policy-dependent visitation couples the row edits, while long horizons make global curvature bounds conservative. From $2d+2$ Bellman solves, we derive reusable envelopes that support uniform and candidate-specific guarantees before rounding. A rank-two rational representation of each exchange further permits weighted curvature integration along the realized trajectory. We prove that linear dimension dependence is unavoidable when the budget scales, and that exact global curvature thresholding is hard. translated_title: 面向MDP中稀疏策略部署的贝尔曼认证舍入方法
translated_abstract: 连续策略优化可能会将更新分散到许多状态上，即使部署场景只允许进行少量完整的状态级更改。我们研究了在有限MDP中，当连续的行混合策略被舍入为稀疏二值策略时，能够保留多少折扣回报。依赖于策略的访问分布将各行编辑耦合在一起，而长时程使得全局曲率界过于保守。通过 $2d+2$ 次贝尔曼求解，我们导出了可复用的包络界，可在舍入之前支持统一保证和针对特定候选策略的保证。每次交换的秩二有理表示进一步允许沿实际轨迹进行加权曲率积分。我们证明了当预算规模扩大时，线性维度依赖是不可避免的，且精确的全局曲率阈值化是计算困难的。在结构化测试套件上，针对特定候选策略的界将舍入前的认证覆盖率从 48.2% 提升至 74.1%。在 $\gamma=0.95$ 时，局部积分降低了……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出通过仅 $2d+2$ 次贝尔曼求解导出可复用的包络界，在将连续策略舍入为稀疏二值策略之前即可提供统一及针对候选策略的回报保证，并将舍入前认证覆盖率从 48.2% 提升至 74.1%。
en_tdlr: This paper derives reusable envelopes from only $2d+2$ Bellman solves that provide uniform and candidate-specific guarantees before rounding continuous policies to sparse binary ones, raising pre-rounding certification coverage from 48.2% to 74.1%.
